blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – More than 16,000 visitors were recorded at Manila Memorial Park in Sucat on Friday, exceeding the cemetery’s expected count of 15,000. According to cemetery authorities, security personnel recorded 16,183 visitors as of 12 noon, two days ahead of All Saints’ Day. READ: LIVE UPDATES: Undas 2026 | Oct. 30 It was the detachment commander of the Manila Memorial Park who earlier estimated the 15,000 visitor count. A total of 25 security personnel are patrolling the park grounds to ensure public safety.
